en: Vintage sepia postcard with two landscape photographs. The upper image shows a pond or small lake with sandy banks, surrounded by forest and fields, with a small bridge visible in the distance; it is labeled "Grödener Teich." The lower image is a panoramic view over the rooftops of a rural village set in flat countryside; this view is labeled "Totalansicht." At the bottom of the card, the location is printed as "Gröden, Kreis Liebenwerda." The layout and typography resemble early‑20th‑century German postcards.
